headline: pyspi detrend equals the closed-form OLS residual: 12/12 detonly runs pass, max abs 8.53e-14. Truncate -> detrend -> zscore matches numpy: 12/12 pass, max abs 1.39e-13. Historical order differs from the current one by a per-row factor c: cov changes by c_i c_j (up to 0.792), spearman not at all (0.0). Flat or linear channels are accepted at every T (4/4 flat runs fail).

ddof=1 z-score matches numpy: 12/12 pass, max abs 4.4e-16. cov_EmpiricalCovariance equals (T-1)/T * r to 5.5e-15. The supplement's 'equivalent' claim is off by a relative error of exactly 1/T. The constant-channel error message talks about NaNs, and nan_policy='omit' has no effect.

Only the first array is z-scored; row 1 reaches the SPI bit-identical to the raw input. Direct raw path vs kernel on z-scored data: dtw 159.48 vs 8.714, lmfit_Ridge 31.71 vs 0.3245, cov via list 8.085 vs 0.818. The Data path and the z-scored direct path agree to <= 2.2e-16. Unset i/j gives 0 warnings over 285 identifiers: cds and igci return finite values, 10 infotheory identifiers return NaN.

Toy SPI matches exactly: 20 calls for P=5, 10 of them overwritten, upper triangle kept. gc_gaussian A[i,j] equals kernel TE(i->j) to 3e-14. 15 mirror classes and Barycenter are bit-exactly symmetric. 4 bypass spectral classes are antisymmetric (already documented). 18 of 50 mirror identifiers depend on visiting order, 10 of them beyond rounding (xcorr up to 0.081, coint_aeg up to 7.41, je_kozachenko 1.6e-7). Only TE, PSI and gd follow 'row = source'.

Two-sided CSM vs independent kernel: max|dS|/max|S| <= 1.08e-12 over 31 runs (T 64-4096, kernel and pipeline paths, odd and padded n_fft). Coherency: 4.7e-12. mne_connectivity with symmetric DPSS and unit weights: 4.7e-12. mne defaults differ by up to 0.0305, fully explained by eigenvalue weights. Tapers 1.3e-13, concentrations 2.3e-15 (min 0.946). Hermitian residual 0.0 and Im S(0) = 0.0. Statistical check against analytic VAR S(f): max_z 1.52 (threshold 2). Phase-slope direction agreement 1.0. Score is 9, not 10, because the documented 125-bin grid from f0 = 4/T is not the grid this path uses.

headline: pyspi's own reducers, instrumented, select inclusive bins on the multivariate path and strict bins on the bivariate path (exact, 5 runs). cohmag/icoh match the inclusive set to 1.5e-13; the strict set would differ by up to 0.515. dcoh/DTF match the strict set to 1.1e-15; the inclusive set would differ by 0.0017-0.129. The f = 0.25 bin is counted twice under the inclusive rule (residual <= 4.8e-13) and not at all under the strict rule (1.4e-13). PSI sums over 47/43/43 bins at T=1024. EEG bands at T=1024: PSI raises IndexError and GD is all-NaN for 0.5-2, 2-4 and 4-6 /1024.

The independent re-implementation passes 120/120 runs (max_abs 7.6e-13 kernel, 8.9e-14 pipeline, 1.3e-13 detrend), the EEG bands agree to 1.0e-13, and the identical pair gives exactly 1. The value is |C|^2: the unsquared |C| differs by 0.212 on bivariate T=4096 (0.2647 vs 0.4766). mne coh^2 agrees to 7.9e-5, while mne coh differs by 0.204. Because K is fixed at 5, the null level stays at 0.20 for every T, and the var2 value at T=4096 is 0.3648 against a population MSC of 0.2465 (pop max_z 12.53; within the Monte Carlo spread of the estimator, max_z 0.60).

The arithmetic mean and max of principal angles, DC included, are reproduced exactly in 120/120 runs (max_abs 1.3e-11). The sign convention holds: A[i,j] > 0 means i leads j (delayed_noise low band +0.7768 vs analytic +0.7854; direction agreement 1.0; f0 bin within 1.7e-3 of phi_i - phi_j). Against the circular mean: delayed_noise A[3,0] -0.320 vs -1.565 (max_abs 2.879), and var2 T=4096 high band 1.1765 vs population 2.4658 (max_z 10.88). The DC identity A + A.T = 2 pi [Re S(0) < 0] / n_bins holds exactly. The max statistic saturates near pi (null 3.1413 at T=4096).

|Im C| per bin, then the band statistic, is reproduced exactly in 120/120 runs (max_abs 7.4e-13). The f0 bin is within 1.1e-3 of |sin dphi|. Against Nolte's signed Im C: delayed_noise A01 = A10 = 0.6293 vs +/-0.6283 (max_abs 1.2575), and pair (0,3) 0.6315 vs a signed band mean of 0.1262. mne |imcoh| agrees to 7.1e-5, while signed imcoh differs by 0.700. The null level is 0.26 for every T, and a zero-lag bivariate pair gives 0.2437 against a population value of 0 (max_z 27.49).

pyspi exactly matches an independent all-pairs replica: rep/alone/base 101/101 and EEG 31/31, max_abs 5.87e-10 at |A| up to about 800, max relative 3.9e-11, NaN masks identical. Nolte 2008 eq. 3 is a different quantity. On delayed_noise the ratio pyspi/Nolte is 9-275 (median 34-143) and the Spearman rank correlation across pairs is -0.94 to -1.0. Signs agree with Nolte in 17/30 runs; the fails come from noise in the sample Nolte value, and pyspi agrees with the population sign on the VAR datasets. MNE adjacent-pair PSI agrees with our Nolte reference to 2.5e-3. The REVIEW M5 example is reproduced: library +1.1168, adjacent -1.3070. Long delays of 55/60/80 samples get the reversed sign (direction agreement 0.7). Three of the 10 EEG bands raise IndexError and come out all-NaN at T=1024. Rubric anchor 2.

pyspi exactly matches an independent replica of the library pipeline: rep/alone/base 125/125 and EEG 37/37, max_abs 4.2e-11, NaN masks identical. On delayed_noise the direction check passes 9/9 and the delay error is at most 0.081 samples. It agrees with plain OLS to 0.033. Adding channels changes results (6/8 embed fails, from pooled Benjamini-Hochberg). White noise gives spurious delays at T=64: 4/20 entries in the full band and 6/20 in the high band, with step 1. The VAR population delay of +1.13 comes out with the wrong sign (-0.47) at T=256 and as NaN at T>=1024. EEG bands with 0 bins raise ValueError and bands with 1-2 bins come out all-NaN. Rubric anchor 6 (group-delay significance machinery).

Reweighted FAST-MCD covariance, computed exactly as sklearn 1.9.1 defines it. Given the same raw subset, robustbase covMcd agrees to max_rel 3.51e-15 on 7/8 rdet runs; the 8th differs by one reweighting point in the band created by the h-1 vs h raw-divisor convention. rrcov's own search agrees within the combined seed range on 5/6. The fail is contaminated|256: 0.00576 vs atol 0.00373, because rrcov reaches raw log det -6.4858 and sklearn only -6.4630. Analytic stat runs pass 11/12 (the iid|1024 null draw fails at raw z 3.65). sklearn's seed-42 subset is the best found in only 3/14 optimality runs. 20-seed spread is 0.155-0.257 at T=64 and 0.0027-0.0044 at T=4096. The documented range [-1,1] is violated (1.141).

Bitwise equal to cov_MinCovDet under the same seed (eeqmcd 8/8). Same external picture: rdet 5/6, rrcov 5/6 (same contaminated|256 fail), stat 2/2, robust correlation 0.8071 vs 0.8. In a Calculator pass it differs from cov_MinCovDet only through RNG position (up to 0.111 at T=64).

Inverse of the reweighted FAST-MCD scatter. robustbase plus a numpy inverse agrees to max_rel 2.97e-13 on 7/8 runs; rrcov agrees 6/6. Analytic Omega*s*s target: 10/11. It is not the documented partial correlation: -2.480 where the partial correlation is +0.8 (max_z 18.0). Values are unbounded (368.3 on narrowband|64). Singular input returns a finite pseudo-inverse (prec(0,2) = 0.446, input rank 3 of 4).

Bitwise equal to prec_MinCovDet under the same seed (8/8). rdet 5/6, rrcov 6/6, stat 2/2, pcorr 0/2, silent pseudo-inverse on singular input. In a Calculator pass it differs from prec_MinCovDet only by RNG position (0.134 at T=64). The EEG selection keeps both as separate features.
